backend/models/__init__.py.docstring:
Levelith Domain Models

This module contains the core domain models for the Levelith application.
All models follow the architecture defined in MANIFEST.md.

Models:
    - User: User account and profile
    - Experience: Base class for all experience types
    - Education experiences: Certificate, Degree, Course
    - Workplace experiences: Gig, PartTime, FullTime
    - Skills experiences: SoftSkill, HardSkill, NativeSkill

backend/models/experience.py.docstring:
Experience Domain Models

This module defines the core Experience model and all its subtypes.
According to MANIFEST.md, there are 9 experience subtypes across 3 categories:

1. Education: Certificate, Degree, Course
2. Workplace: Gig, PartTime, FullTime
3. Skills: SoftSkill, HardSkill, NativeSkill

Every Experience MUST have a NAICS code. Fallback code: 123456 (GENERAL)

backend/models/user.py.docstring:
User Domain Model

This module defines the User model for the Levelith application.
Users have username/password authentication and maintain an array of experiences.

According to MANIFEST.md:
- Authentication: Username + password (traditional authentication)
- JWT tokens for session management
- Secure password hashing (bcrypt)
- Each user has an array of Experience objects

dev/test_debugger.py.docstring:
Test System Debugger

Debugging utilities for the Levelith test system.
Provides detailed diagnostics, failure analysis, and troubleshooting tools.

Usage:
    python dev/test_debugger.py diagnose               # Full system diagnostic
    python dev/test_debugger.py analyze-failure <test> # Analyze specific test failure
    python dev/test_debugger.py coverage-gaps          # Find coverage gaps
    python dev/test_debugger.py validate-all           # Validate all test files

tests/__init__.py.docstring:
Levelith-2 Test Suite

This package contains all tests for the Levelith-2 project.

Test Organization:
- unit/: Unit tests for individual components
- integration/: Integration tests for component interactions
- e2e/: End-to-end tests for complete workflows
- fixtures/: Shared test fixtures and data

Golden Rule: Every code change must include tests.
Minimum coverage: 80%
